title: This Niche Business Makes $20,000/Job
promo_conflict: The speaker describes his own junk-removal operation and promotes the niche-service strategy; no paid sponsorship is disclosed.

idea.name: Remote junk removal
idea.one_liner: A junk-removal service attracts online bookings and dispatches jobs to subcontractors, charging customers for removal.
idea.customer: Households and other junk-removal customers in served areas
idea.offer: Online booking and remote coordination of junk pickup
idea.revenue_model: Service fees per job; pricing is not stated

key_quotes.quote: So, I book jobs online on our website and send the jobs out to the subcontractors, and they go do the labor, pick up the junk for me, and I just manage it all remotely from the computer.

claims.claim: The speaker says his operation serves over 40 cities.
claims.quote: We operate in over 40 cities nationwide, and it's all using subcontractors.

acquisition_channels.details: The speaker says he targets specific service keywords in specific locations.
Customers book jobs on the company website.

ideas.delivery: The speaker books jobs online, dispatches them to subcontractors, and manages the work remotely.
ideas.other_uk_rules: Waste-carrier registration and waste duty of care may apply. Check worker status and whether Employment Agencies Regulations 2003 apply to subcontractor arrangements; UK GDPR applies to enquiry data.
